title: Teleshko introduces licenses

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: There's something I'm supposed to talk to you about. I don't want to say it, and I suspect you won't want to hear it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's something I'm supposed to talk to you about. I don't want to say it, and I suspect you won't want to hear it.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: It's your business license. Your first. Potentially, your first of MANY.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's your business license. Your first. Potentially, your first of MANY.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I am talking about the noodle bar. And your LICCY.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am talking about the noodle bar. And your LICCY.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: License to Increase Capital through Commerce. LICCY is the colloquial term, which I hate. Obviously.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: License to Increase Capital through Commerce. LICCY is the colloquial term, which I hate. Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: A basic one. You have a license for one business. It's called a Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A basic one. You have a license for one business. It's called a Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Please don't call it that. A Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce allows you to operate a business. Thaddeus left you one for the noodle bar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please don't call it that. A Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce allows you to operate a business. Thaddeus left you one for the noodle bar.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You have a Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce, which allows you to operate a business. Thaddeus left you one for the noodle bar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have a Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce, which allows you to operate a business. Thaddeus left you one for the noodle bar.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Well, like it or not, and I am favoring "not", you are now a licensed business owner. Potentially, you could now apply for more licenses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, like it or not, and I am favoring "not", you are now a licensed business owner. Potentially, you could now apply for more licenses.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: It's not a choice, and I need to support you. "Mandatory Growth." It's the sunlight under which all businesses flourish. And the sun doesn't set on business in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not a choice, and I need to support you. "Mandatory Growth." It's the sunlight under which all businesses flourish. And the sun doesn't set on business in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You have to try. Failure is its own punishment. But if you pass up opportunities for growth, like turn down LICCS, you'll have CorpSec to answer to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have to try. Failure is its own punishment. But if you pass up opportunities for growth, like turn down LICCS, you'll have CorpSec to answer to.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Yes... Yes, very good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... Yes, very good.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: It's a good job it's not your choice then. The wisdom of the system dictates what you must do. Mandates it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a good job it's not your choice then. The wisdom of the system dictates what you must do. Mandates it.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Well look, I'm not a fan of yours. Nor a friend. We aren't close. Nor will we ever be. In fact, I don't even wish you well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well look, I'm not a fan of yours. Nor a friend. We aren't close. Nor will we ever be. In fact, I don't even wish you well.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Yes, well... I have another business in mind. And I don't think you're... a complete lost cause. And that's more than I can say for most of the people we're trapped here with.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well... I have another business in mind. And I don't think you're... a complete lost cause. And that's more than I can say for most of the people we're trapped here with.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I hardly see how that's relevant. The business in question is Brooke's Bodega. Go there and speak to the - ugh - proprietor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hardly see how that's relevant. The business in question is Brooke's Bodega. Go there and speak to the - ugh - proprietor.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Very good. The business in question is Brooke's Bodega. Go there and speak to the - ugh - proprietor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very good. The business in question is Brooke's Bodega. Go there and speak to the - ugh - proprietor.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: About time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About time.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: What? Oh, that was just to get your attention. To make sure I didn't have to tolerate your tardiness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Oh, that was just to get your attention. To make sure I didn't have to tolerate your tardiness.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I do not have time to spoon-feed you like a tiny baby. Speak to Brooke and use your LIMITED initiative. That is all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do not have time to spoon-feed you like a tiny baby. Speak to Brooke and use your LIMITED initiative. That is all.
